notes: A server you create or reopen on this PC signs you in with your saved account; no password page. Call screens now look and work like Discord: tiles with speaking rings, a Discord-style call bar, a share picker with live thumbnails, camera preview and stream pop-out. Hosting ranks PCs by measurement and each LAN elects one voice gateway without gaps. The comparison-only noise models are no longer built in, so the app is smaller; Studio stays on DPDFNet. Includes a new client and schema-31 server. Verified with tests and screenshots, not yet in a live two-person call.
